hero.titleLead: Your business grows when you don't have to
hero.subtitle: Delegate your administrative, accounting and marketing tasks. You stay focused on what truly drives results.

items.title: Social media
items.description: Content creation, post scheduling, profile management, advertising on Facebook and Instagram, analytics and reporting.
details: Creating graphics and video content (Reels, Stories, photo posts)
Planning and scheduling posts in advance
Profile management on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok
Responding to comments and reviews
Managing paid ads and campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
Detailed monthly reports and analytics

items.title: Bookkeeping
items.description: Basic bookkeeping support, issuing and tracking invoices, expense records, VAT filings and preparing documentation for your accountant.
details: Recording incoming and outgoing invoices
VAT calculation and filing VAT returns
Reconciling customer and supplier balances
Payroll processing and employee record-keeping
Preparing and submitting JOPPD forms
Sick leave, holiday and absence records
Preparing documentation for your accountant or the Tax Administration

items.title: Administration
items.description: Email and calendar management, document preparation, registration of foreign workers, travel planning and coordination of business processes.
details: Email and calendar management
Document archiving and organisation
Data entry and processing, report preparation
Registering and deregistering foreign workers (HZMO, HZZO, MUP)
Responding to customer enquiries and sending reminders
Coordinating and organising booked groups (hospitality)
Organising business travel and meetings

about.label: About
about.title: Why Adria VA?
paragraphs: Dedicated, ambitious and always eager to learn — these are the qualities I bring to your business too. Adria VA was born out of a love for work and a wish to help entrepreneurs who want to grow but lack the time for every administrative task.
I adapt to the needs of each client because an individual approach matters to me. Instead of one generic solution, you get support that fits your way of working.
By working with a virtual assistant you can delegate the tasks that eat up your time and focus on growing your company.
